summary: Enviri II Corp. (New Enviri) filed an 8-K disclosing the completion of a spin-off from Enviri Corporation on June 1, 2026. Pursuant to a Separation Agreement, Enviri merged into a subsidiary (Holding Company Merger), a reorganization split Clean Earth (sold to Veolia) from Harsco Environmental and Rail (New Enviri business), with New Envivi shares distributed to CLEH stockholders. New Enviri common stock trades on NYSE under NVRI (WI). The transaction separates two distinct industrial segments. Watch for post-spin trading dynamics and potential value realization in the separated entities.
